description: This PHP source file defines the SaveQualificationSkillController class, which manages the pre-rendering logic for qualification skill forms in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It determines whether to load an edit or save component based on the request attributes.

classes.name: SaveQualificationSkillController
classes.description: A controller class that handles the pre-rendering logic to set up qualification skill components for editing or creating new qualifications.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the appropriate component based on whether an 'id' attribute exists in the request, indicating edit mode; otherwise, prepares the save component.
